title: SymfonyCon Warsaw 2026: Mercure 1.0: Real-Time Symfony, Eight Years On
content: <html><head></head><body>Want to level up your PHP and Symfony game? SymfonyCon Warsaw 2026 is heading to Poland this November 26-27. Join devs from all over the world for two solid days packed with 3 parallel tracks and community events. Grab your spot and get ready!…</body></html>
author: Mélyne FREUZE
